prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore a deleted episode and its cuts at its former position, along with an Undo action in the delete notification on the Episodes page in both languages and tests.

+    """Ensure active episodes for a project are numbered 1..N with no gaps or repeats."""
+    episodes = list(

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select

+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Workspace, WorkspaceMember, User

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title, order, summary=""):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="single",
+    aspect_ratio="1:1",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_metadata_order_and_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(
+        client,
+        h,
+        project["id"],
+        title="The First Stop",
+        order=1,
+        summary="A passenger boards at midnight.",
+    )
+    ep2 = _create_episode(
+        client,
+        h,
+        project["id"],
+        title="The Second Stop",
+        order=2,
+        summary="The bus crosses the bridge.",
+    )
+
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Wide shot of the empty bus stop in the rain.",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Last bus tonight."}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-1", "name": "Driver"}],
+        image_path="http://minio.local/cuts/cut1.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Close-up on the wet ticket in her hand.",
+        selected_layout="single",
+        aspect_ratio="1:1",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait for me!"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-2", "name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path="cuts/ep1/cut2.png",
+    )
+
+    dup_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert dup_res.status_code == 200, dup_res.text
+    dup = dup_res.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "A passenger boards at midnight."
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"] == "http://minio.local/cuts/cut1.png"
+
+    # Copy goes right after its original, and later episodes move down one place
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Cuts are copied in the same order with scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters, and images
+    orig_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 2
+
+    for orig_cut, dup_cut in zip(orig_cuts, dup_cuts):
+        assert dup_cut["id"] != orig_cut["id"]
+        assert dup_cut["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+        assert dup_cut["cut_order"] == orig_cut["cut_order"]
+        assert dup_cut["script"] == orig_cut["script"]
+        assert dup_cut["dialogues"] == orig_cut["dialogues"]
+        assert dup_cut["selected_layout"] == orig_cut["selected_layout"]
+        assert dup_cut["aspect_ratio"] == orig_cut["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert dup_cut["appearing_characters"] == orig_cut["appearing_characters"]
+        assert dup_cut["image_path"] == orig_cut["image_path"]
+
+

+def test_episode_order_is_always_contiguous_across_duplicate_and_delete(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 1 -> [Ep 1 (1), Ep 1 Copy (2), Ep 2 (3), Ep 3 (4)]
+    dup1 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup1["episode_order"] == 2
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 2 (now at order 3) -> [Ep 1 (1), Ep 1 Copy (2), Ep 2 (3), Ep 2 Copy (4), Ep 3 (5)]
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 4
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup1["id"], ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
+
+    # Delete Ep 1 Copy (order 2) -> closes the gap: [Ep 1 (1), Ep 2 (2), Ep 2 Copy (3), Ep 3 (4)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete Ep 1 (order 1) -> closes the gap: [Ep 2 (1), Ep 2 Copy (2), Ep 3 (3)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
